title: AI model to summarize, rate, and flag potentially harmful clauses found in terms of service or privacy policy agreements for digital services
summary: A Zambian research project proposes summaries and warnings for potentially harmful terms-of-service and privacy-policy clauses.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed model would summarize agreements and flag clauses that could compromise users’ rights or privacy. It is described as a final-year research project without a pilot. Better understanding and more informed service choices are intended benefits.
purpose: Help users understand digital-service agreements and potentially problematic clauses.
system: AI model to summarize, rate, and flag potentially harmful clauses found in terms of service or privacy policy agreements for digital services

ratings.reason: The terms-of-service tool is a final-year research proposal with no pilot or documented user decision.
More accountable business practices and transparency are projected effects.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: AI model to summarize, rate, and flag potentially harmful clauses found in terms of service or privacy policy agreements for digital services

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A research proposal makes digital-service terms easier to read
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
